read_file_with_line_numbers: read a file from the repository worktree and return its content with line numbers
inspect_file_whitespace: inspect exact whitespace and indentation for specific lines in a file to debug edit failures
list_directory_contents: list files and directories in a given path within the repository
grep_file_for_pattern: search a file for a regex pattern and return matching lines with optional context
edit_file_by_text: replace exact text in a file by providing the old string and new string
